name: Numonic API
description:
Numonic is an AI-native digital asset management platform. This API lets you store, search, organize, and automate operations on creative assets (images, video, audio, 3D models) with full provenance tracking, metadata preservation, and compliance-ready publishing.

**Getting started:** Authenticate with a [Numonic API key](https://numonic.ai/docs/api#authentication) (`napi_` prefix). All endpoints are tenant-scoped — pass `X-Tenant-ID` if your key has access to multiple tenants.

**Related:** [MCP Tool Reference](https://numonic.ai/docs/api/mcp) · [Search Syntax](https://numonic.ai/docs/search) · [Glossary](https://numonic.ai/glossary)
